What you’ll learnCourse contentPreviews

What you’ll learn

  • Set up your business portfolio, ad account, payment settings and secure access.
  • Follow real WhatsApp campaign screens for the destination, budget, schedule, location and audience controls.
  • Test the complete customer journey, handle enquiries and review useful results.
  • Work through phone-call, website-traffic and Shopify-sales campaign scenarios.
  • Research public competitor ads in Meta Ad Library and turn observations into a creative test.
  • Choose a Pixel installation route, map real action events and verify the browser and Meta Test Events.
  • Understand Conversions API, browser/server event deduplication, consent and troubleshooting.
  • Complete the campaign worksheets and website-measurement sign-off checklist.

Requirements

You will need an eligible Meta account and access to the business assets you use. Running ads requires a separate advertising budget. The WhatsApp example does not require a website; the Pixel lessons require an eligible website you are authorised to configure.

About this guide

For business owners and marketers who want campaign foundations, a practical public-ad research method and a structured approach to website measurement.

Begin with the business foundations, follow a real WhatsApp campaign walkthrough, then practise researching public ads and checking website measurement. The worksheets help you plan a small test and review what happened.

An independent Ascore educational course. Meta screens, policies and eligibility can change. Interface captures are sanitised teaching examples; Pixel implementation guidance is clearly labelled. Advertising performance and certification are not guaranteed.

A few useful answers

Know what you’re choosing.

Is this a video course?

No. These are self-paced English PDF guides. Meta has 54 pages and Practical AI has 42. Read, try the exercises and return to the sections you need.

Can I purchase and download now?

This is a checkout preview. Paid purchasing and PDF delivery are unavailable. You can read the samples, explore the outline and review a cart. Reviewing a cart does not place an order.

What is included in AED 50?

One PDF course. Advertising spend, tool subscriptions, API usage and live training are separate. Purchase terms and tax details will be available before paid checkout opens.

Do I need experience or a paid tool plan?

The Meta guide begins with foundations. You need eligible accounts and authorised access to the assets you use. Running ads requires a separate budget. Website measurement lessons need a website you are authorised to configure.

Are these official platform courses?

No. These independent guides are created by Ascore Creative. They are not endorsed by Meta, OpenAI or Anthropic and do not promise certification, leads or sales. Interfaces and availability can change.

How can I ask a question?

Email info@ascore.ae or ask about live training on WhatsApp. Sending an enquiry is your choice.
